\section{MedSAM paper}
\begin{frame}[t]{The evaluation object is overlap under a prompted mask}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=\paperwidth,y=-\paperheight]
\path[use as bounding box] (0,0.12) rectangle (1,0.82);
\StageThreeNode{0.2050}{0.2596}{0.6800}{center}{\LARGE \[\displaystyle \operatorname{DSC}(G,S)=\frac{2\lvert G\cap S\rvert}{\lvert G\rvert+\lvert S\rvert}\]};
\StageThreeNode{0.1200}{0.4700}{0.7600}{center}{\normalsize Here G is the expert annotation and S is the predicted segmentation mask; the paper reports DSC for internal and external validation tasks.};
\StageThreePanel{0.0900}{0.5800}{0.5050}{0.7700};
\StageThreeNode{0.1050}{0.6000}{0.3850}{left}{\footnotesize\textbf{Model components}\\[-0.10em]\scriptsize\textbullet\ ground-truth mask G\\\scriptsize\textbullet\ segmentation mask S\\\scriptsize\textbullet\ Dice similarity coefficient};
\StageThreePanel{0.4950}{0.5800}{0.9100}{0.7700};
\StageThreeNode{0.5100}{0.6000}{0.3850}{left}{\footnotesize\textbf{Interpretation}\\[-0.10em]MedSAM is judged by segmentation overlap after a bounding-box prompt specifies the target region.};
\StageThreeNode{0.1200}{0.7900}{0.7600}{center}{\scriptsize Source: Ma et al. 2024 Methods, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-44824-z.};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{frame}
